It also prepares OSHA HazCom citation abatement packages with written hazard communication programs and runs a cloud SDS management library with QR-code access.

entries.title: Pace SDS authoring services
entries.description: Pace Analytical, a US environmental and analytical laboratory network with its corporate office in Roseville, Minnesota, authors SDSs and labels for domestic and international markets through its Professional Services product stewardship group, for single SDSs and large-volume projects, with product label reviews and foreign-language translations. The group also covers TSCA inventory checks, chemical data reporting and Prop 65 warning label language.

entries.title: The Acta Group GHS practice
entries.description: The Acta Group is a scientific and regulatory consulting firm for companies that make and use chemicals, with offices in Washington, D.C., Manchester and Brussels; it is the consulting affiliate of the law firm Bergeson & Campbell, P.C. Its GHS practice classifies substances, prepares and reviews SDSs and labels for UN GHS, EU CLP, OSHA HCS and WHMIS, and runs GHS training; other practices cover US TSCA, EU and UK REACH (including Only Representative services) and dangerous goods transport.

entries.title: ToxServices regulatory compliance
entries.description: ToxServices LLC is a toxicology and scientific consulting firm founded in 2003, headquartered in Washington, D.C., with an office in Ann Arbor, Michigan. Its regulatory compliance services include safety data sheet preparation, product label review for Federal Hazardous Substances Act requirements, toxicological risk assessments and agency notifications, with work under TSCA, Proposition 65, EU CLP and REACH.

entries.title: KHA Online-SDS
entries.description: Online-SDS is a web-based safety data sheet management system from Kelleher, Helmrich and Associates, Inc. (KHA) in Merrillville, Indiana. It indexes a facility's chemical inventory, updates SDSs across the organisation, archives outdated sheets and prints secondary container labels in GHS, NFPA, HMIS and US DOT formats.

entries.title: Data Sheet Solutions SDS management software
entries.description: SDS management software from Data Sheet Solutions LLC in Anaheim, California: an employee SDS library at a custom web address, a barcode-based chemical inventory, secondary-container labels, binders and exports. It is sold as the self-managed SDS Toolbox or as SDS Autopilot, in which the company's team locates, indexes and reviews the documents.

entries.title: SDS BinderWorks
entries.description: SDS BinderWorks is an SDS management subscription with employee access by website, mobile app and custom hardcopy binders, including initial inventory creation, SDS update notifications, automated archiving and secondary container labels. It is operated by Mechanical Contractors Association of Iowa, Inc. (d/b/a SDS BinderWorks) in Urbandale, Iowa.

entries.title: GHS InfoSafe SDS Repository
entries.description: GHS InfoSafe provides SDS management services, listing addresses in Syracuse (New York), Mexico City, Swindon and Bengaluru: SDS sourcing and revision updates, indexing, authoring, translation, labelling, and hosting of a client's SDS library on its cloud-based SDS-Cache platform. The site states that it is a subsidiary of GHSISYS.

entries.title: Novara Flex SDS Manager
entries.description: SDS management module of the Novara Flex EHS platform, run by Novara Software, LLC in Westminster, Colorado. It builds a centralized SDS library from a database of over 70 million SDSs, distributes updated sheets automatically, lets workers search SDSs on phone, tablet or desktop including offline, translates into over 100 languages and fills secondary container labels from SDS data.

entries.title: KPA Vera Suite EHS compliance
entries.description: EHS compliance software and services from KPA Services, LLC (doing business as KPA) in Lafayette, Colorado, for automotive, RV, powersports, marine and truck dealerships, collision centers and auto care shops. The EHS module of its Vera Suite software includes Safety Data Sheet access for employees by QR code alongside OSHA compliance tools, training and quarterly on-site visits.

entries.title: Computype GHS labels
entries.description: Computype, Inc. in St Paul, Minnesota, supplies GHS labels for chemical containers: pre-printed, blank or partially printed labels on synthetic face stocks, blank thermal transfer label kits with black and red ribbons for the cab XC Q two-colour printer, and label printing and converting services. The page says the labels are built to align with the OSHA Hazard Communication Standard and EU CLP.

entries.title: MySafetyLabels GHS labels
entries.description: MySafetyLabels.com is an online label store run by XpressMyself.com LLC, trading as SmartSign, in Brooklyn, New York. Its GHS section sells factory-printed GHS labels, GHS pictogram labels on rolls, GHS secondary container labels and custom GHS labels to which the buyer adds the chemical name, pictograms and hazard details.

entries.title: Iconex chemical drum labels
entries.description: Iconex LLC, a label manufacturer in Morristown, Tennessee, sells chemical drum labels that it describes as an OSHA- and GHS-compliant labelling solution for industrial chemicals. The labels are made to BS5609-compliant performance, printed in up to six process colours, and supplied as pre-printed writable labels or as media for printing on demand with laser or thermal transfer printers.

entries.title: TSC Printronix Auto ID GHS label media
entries.description: TSC Printronix Auto ID, the thermal label printer business of TSC Auto ID Technology Co., Ltd. of New Taipei City, Taiwan, sells GHS-approved label media and resin ribbons for printing GHS labels on its own printers through its US and Canada site. It also supplies printed labels that it states are GHS and BS5609 certified, including chemical drum labels.

entries.title: AstroNova QuickLabel GHS drum label printers
entries.description: AstroNova, Inc. of West Warwick, Rhode Island, sells QuickLabel inkjet label printers (QL-120D, QL-425, QL-435, QL-900) and GetLabels label materials for printing GHS drum labels in-house. The page states that the label materials are GHS compliant and meet BS5609 Sections 2 and 3 with water-based pigment ink, and use a marine-grade adhesive.

entries.title: ClickSafety Hazard Communication (HazCom/GHS) online courses
entries.description: ClickSafety, Inc. is an online safety training company in Burlington, Massachusetts, part of Ascend Learning, with a catalogue of over 500 self-paced courses including OSHA 10 and 30 Outreach training. Its hazard communication courses cover OSHA's Hazard Communication Standard and GHS for all industries (also in Spanish), for managers and supervisors, and container labeling.

entries.title: 360training Hazard Communication (HazCom) Training
entries.description: 360training is an online training company in Austin, Texas, founded in 1997, whose OSHAcampus brand sells OSHA Outreach and workplace safety courses. Its self-paced Hazard Communication (HazCom) course, in English and Spanish, covers 29 CFR 1910.1200, the 16 GHS-aligned sections of a safety data sheet, chemical label elements and a written hazard communication program.

entries.title: OSHA Training Services online Hazard Communication / GHS training courses
entries.description: OSHA Training Services Inc. is a safety training company headquartered in Arlington, Texas, founded in 2011, that runs instructor-led OSHA training across the United States and sells online courses. Its online hazard communication courses are initial employee training for general industry and for construction plus an annual refresher, based on the training requirements of OSHA's Hazard Communication standard (1910.1200).

entries.title: Safety Unlimited OSHA Hazard Communication (HAZCOM) Training
entries.description: Safety Unlimited, Inc. is a safety training and consulting company in Simi Valley, California, with training centres in California, Arizona, North Carolina and New Jersey. Its hazard communication courses are an online OSHA Hazard Communication (HAZCOM) course aligned with GHS under 29 CFR 1910.1200, also offered in Spanish and with an optional wallet ID card, and a classroom version for federal OSHA or Cal/OSHA.

entries.title: J. J. Keller Hazard Communication (HazCom) training
entries.description: J. J. Keller & Associates, Inc. is a regulatory, safety and compliance publisher and services company headquartered in Neenah, Wisconsin, founded in 1953. For OSHA's Hazard Communication Standard it sells online courses on hazard communication and GHS container labels, a HazCom training program on USB or download and on-site training, as well as HazCom labels and a Chemical Management Service that acquires and tracks safety data sheets.

entries.title: Aegis Regulatory GHS-Compliant SDS & Labels
entries.description: Aegis Regulatory Inc. is a chemical regulatory compliance company in London, Ontario, that prepares GHS safety data sheets and hazard communication labels for the United States (OSHA HazCom 2012), Canada (WHMIS), Mexico (NOM-018-STPS-2015) and Europe (EU and GB CLP). The service covers hazard classification, label elements, Canadian DSL and US TSCA ingredient checks and dangerous goods classification, with SDSs available in more than 20 languages.

entries.title: ICC Compliance Center SDS Services
entries.description: ICC Compliance Center, a supplier of dangerous goods and workplace safety compliance products and services with offices in Canada and the United States, creates, reformats, updates, reviews and translates safety data sheets to WHMIS, OSHA HazCom 2012 and European REACH/CLP requirements, with translation into more than 30 languages including Canadian French. It also supplies hazard labels, placards and packaging, custom-printed labels and WHMIS and GHS training.

entries.title: Kalium Solutions SDS and WHMIS services
entries.description: Kalium Solutions inc. is a chemist-led regulatory consulting firm in Saint-Lazare, Québec, founded in 2015, that authors and validates safety data sheets and WHMIS labels, translates SDSs and runs WHMIS and TDG training. It also rents cloud SDS authoring software for WHMIS (Hazardous Products Regulations), OSHA HCS 2024 and EU CLP, and offers a bilingual cloud SDS management service in which a chemist validates every imported SDS.

entries.title: CanadaSDS
entries.description: CanadaSDS is cloud-based SDS management software for WHMIS compliance across Canada's provinces and territories, run by OHS Technologies Inc. (DBA CanadaSDS), part of the Toronto-based Quadshift group. It keeps a bilingual English/French SDS library with supplier revision updates, chemical inventory, GHS workplace labels, QR codes, iOS and Android apps and the Rex AI assistant, and also offers SDS authoring software and authoring services.

entries.title: CCOHS CANManage
entries.vendor: Canadian Centre for Occupational Health and Safety (CCOHS)
entries.description: CANManage is an online safety data sheet management service run by the Canadian Centre for Occupational Health and Safety (CCOHS), a federal departmental corporation in Hamilton, Ontario. It gives an organization online and mobile access to its collection of English and French safety data sheets, with workplace label printing, Excel and eBinder exports and offline access. CCOHS also sells WHMIS e-courses, an SDS database and CHEMINFO.

entries.title: Répertoire toxicologique
entries.description: The Répertoire toxicologique of Québec's occupational health and safety board (CNESST) is a French-language database of information on chemical and biological products used in the workplace, run by a multidisciplinary scientific team in chemistry, toxicology and workplace hygiene. It includes a WHMIS (SIMDUT) classification list of more than 2,000 substances established by CNESST staff under the Hazardous Products Regulations, searchable by substance name, CAS number or UN number, with English content limited to the classification list and product summaries.

entries.title: INCOM GHS/Hazcom labels and SDS stations
entries.description: INCOM Manufacturing Group, a family-owned maker of safety identification and compliance labelling products that operated as Top Tape & Label from 1975 to 2012, sells pre-printed GHS/WHMIS hazard pictogram labels on pads and rolls, bilingual English/French SDS information stations and binders, GHS wall charts and fillable workplace label and tag templates through its online store.

entries.title: Capacitación de personal Mx NOM-018-STPS course
entries.description: Capacitación de personal Mx, based in Tepatitlán de Morelos, Jalisco (Mexico), sells training courses with STPS DC-3 certificates. Its NOM-018-STPS page offers an online course with a DC-3 certificate and in-company training for groups from 10 people nationwide, covering the 16-section safety data sheet (HDS) and the nine GHS pictograms required by NOM-018-STPS-2015.

entries.title: GlobalSTD Requerimientos NOM-018-STPS course
entries.description: GlobalSTD is a training provider whose course sheet lists Guadalajara, Mexico City and Monterrey together with Colombia, the USA and Spain. Its 16-hour course on the requirements of NOM-018-STPS-2015 covers employer and worker obligations, the harmonized hazard communication system and substance list, the mandatory sections of a safety data sheet (HDS), signage, training and verification units, and ends with a GlobalSTD certificate of approval.

entries.title: Hemikalije Info chemical adviser training
entries.description: Hemikalije Info is a chemicals-management consultancy and training service in Novi Sad, Serbia, run by a licensed chemical adviser and trainer. It runs a two-day intensive seminar, in Novi Sad or online, that prepares candidates for the Serbian chemical adviser exam, and in-house training at client companies on safety data sheets, hazard assessment and label elements. It also supports safety data sheet preparation and Chemical Register filings.

entries.title: Savetnik za hemikalije
entries.description: Savetnik za hemikalije is a chemicals-management advisory service in Serbia run by a licensed chemical adviser. It prepares and revises safety data sheets for substances and mixtures and translates those of imported chemicals, classifies substances and mixtures under the CLP/GHS system, checks and prepares labels, and prepares Chemicals Register filings and biocidal product applications.
